info.title: Fenergo Nebula CreditAssessment Query
info.description:
**CreditAssessment Query API**:
CreditAssessment Query API retrieves creditassessments and aggregates.
**CreditAssessment Query API provides**:
  • The ability to retrieve credit assessment results for an entity. JourneyId + TaskId + EntityId + tenant can be used to retrieve credit assessment results of the entity.
  • The ability to query related objects of Automated Credit Assessments - Including new providers, providers configurations, mapping configurations and adapter schemas.
  • The ability to query related objects of Manual Credit Assessments. Includes Manual Credit Assessment sets and versions.
